name: The Lakes at Thousand Oaks
demographics: The Lakes at Thousand Oaks attracts an affluent, family-oriented demographic from the Conejo Valley area, with visitors typically in the 30-55 age range and above-average household incomes. The trade area serves upscale suburban families seeking convenient access to organic groceries, health and wellness services, and quality dining options. Primary shoppers include health-conscious professionals and parents who value premium services like medspa treatments, fitness programs such as Stroller Strides, and family-friendly activities including the weekly Kids Club events.
description: The Lakes at Thousand Oaks is a premier lifestyle destination in the heart of Thousand Oaks, California, offering a carefully curated mix of daily essentials and upscale amenities. Developed and managed by Caruso, the renowned real estate company known for creating distinctive shopping experiences, this open-air center seamlessly blends organic groceries, fine dining, and wellness services in an inviting lakeside setting. The center features notable tenants including California Pizza Kitchen, Fogo de Chão Brazilian steakhouse, and Kalologie Medspa, catering to health-conscious and discerning shoppers. Family-friendly programming is a cornerstone of the experience, with weekly Kids Club events on The Lawn featuring live music, storytelling, and puppet shows every Wednesday. As part of the exclusive Caruso Signature membership program, visitors can earn rewards while enjoying enhanced events and early access to special offerings, making The Lakes a true community gathering place that goes beyond traditional shopping.
summary: The Lakes at Thousand Oaks is an upscale lifestyle center by Caruso featuring organic groceries, fine dining including California Pizza Kitchen and Fogo de Chão, and wellness services like Kalologie Medspa. The center offers family-friendly programming with weekly Kids Club events and exclusive Caruso Signature membership rewards.
